day_shape: 67 items: reports of a near-agreed US-Iran 60-day ceasefire extension with Iran reportedly surrendering enriched uranium, an Israeli soldier killed by Hezbollah drone with IDF strikes and evacuation alerts across south Lebanon, heavy Khamenei/IRGC Khorramshahr-anniversary messaging, and an alleged IRGC plot to kill Ivanka Trump; no UK Parliament or OFAC items.

threads.label: US-Iran ceasefire extension and uranium deal
threads.summary: Multiple reports said Washington and Tehran were near a 60-day ceasefire extension, with NYT and Axios citing Iranian agreement to give up highly enriched uranium. Trump described a deal as 'largely negotiated' and said he was '50/50' on agreement or strikes, while Rubio said progress had been made.

threads.label: Israeli reaction to emerging Iran deal
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported senior GOP senators calling the alleged terms a 'nightmare for Israel', and Liberman accused Netanyahu of failing to win the war on any front. A NYT report cited by Jerusalem Post said Trump was 'sidelining' Netanyahu on Iran.

threads.label: Hezbollah drone kills IDF soldier; south Lebanon strikes
threads.summary: The IDF announced Staff Sgt. Noam Hamburger of the 401st Armored Brigade was killed by a Hezbollah drone near the Lebanese border, and said it struck Hezbollah sites with at least five reported killed in south Lebanon. IDF Arabic spokesman Adraee issued evacuation alerts for over a dozen villages including Nabatiyeh and Jezzine areas, and the IDF said it dismantled a ~100-metre Hezbollah tunnel in Mount Dov.

threads.label: Alleged IRGC plot against Ivanka Trump
threads.summary: Reports identified an Iraqi IRGC-linked operative, named as al-Saadi, allegedly pledging to kill Ivanka Trump in retaliation for the 2020 killing of Qassem Soleimani. Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post cited the suspect's reported role in attacks on Jewish targets.

threads.label: Khamenei and IRGC Khorramshahr-anniversary messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted messages calling for American bases in the region to be 'shut down', honouring martyr Raisi, and framing Iran's resistance against 'two armies of global terrorism'. The IRGC commander-in-chief said armed forces were ready for a 'devastating and hellish response' to any renewed aggression, and Defa Press quoted Commander Kargar saying the war would end 'with dignity and honour'.

threads.label: Iran domestic security and post-war claims
threads.summary: Defa Press said Mojtaba Kian was hanged in Alborz Province for sending defence-industry information to the US and Israel during the 'Ramadan war', and reported the arrest of 15 people in Fars described as a trained 'rioter and terrorist' network in two cells. IRIB cited the Roads Minister saying war-damage facilities were paid out in under three days across more than 400 affected urban and rural locations, and Pezeshkian told broadcasters no decision would be made without the Supreme Leader's permission.

threads.label: Gaza flotilla activists clash with Spanish police
threads.summary: Times of Israel and Jerusalem Post reported Spanish police beat and detained Gaza flotilla activists at Bilbao Airport, with Israel's Foreign Ministry demanding an explanation from Madrid. France separately announced a ban on Israeli minister Itamar Ben Gvir over 'reprehensible actions' toward the flotilla activists.

events.title_en: Jafari: Iran has challenged the world's largest military power
events.summary_en: The deputy head of the Foundation for Preservation of the Works and Promotion of the Values of Sacred Defence and Resistance said: Iran today has been able to challenge the world's largest military power and this is no small feat. The Iranian nation must be grateful for the blood of the martyrs. I was fortunate to be present in Operation Al-Quds and the liberation of Khorramshahr as a small Basiji. That era was truly unrepeatable and one experienced a faithful life. When we entered Khorramshahr, the streets were full of the steel helmets of Baathist soldiers. The enemy had armed all of Khorramshahr's capacities to prevent Iranian armed forces from penetrating, and did not imagine that Khorramshahr would be liberated.

events.title_en: Minister of Roads and Urban Development: War victims' facilities paid out in less than 3 days
events.summary_en: Facilities relating to damaged units were paid out in less than three days and the process of providing temporary shelter and reconstructing damaged areas continues. The recent war affected people's lives in over 400 urban and rural locations, and addressing the situation of affected households was prioritised. Fulfilling outstanding commitments in the housing sector, developing new financing tools, utilising capital market capacity and strengthening facilities for home purchase and construction are among the government's main programmes for the current year.

events.title_en: Pezeshkian: No decision made without the Leader's permission
events.summary_en: The president in a meeting with managers of the Broadcasting Organisation: No decision outside the framework of the Supreme National Security Council and without coordination and permission from the Supreme Leader will be adopted. When a decision is made in the sphere of diplomacy, all organisations, platforms and trends must support it so that a single, coherent voice from Iran is transmitted to the world. Today the Broadcasting Organisation must be a herald of national unity and cohesion. If we all move together within the framework of the Supreme Leader's directives and preserve national cohesion, the enemies will never achieve their objectives against the country.
